## Maintenance checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm test` and `npm run package-linux` (or the relevant platform package command).
- [ ] Electron context isolation, preload allow-lists, and fuses remain secure.
- [ ] Online and offline behavior, sync replay, and local IDs were considered.
- [ ] Routes, navigation, IndexedDB, and API callers are aligned where applicable.
- [ ] User-facing text is updated in en, es, fr, ja, and ru.
- [ ] Shared behavior is coordinated with backend/web/mobile/SPA as needed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes the user-visible change.
